tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Show this agent, its owner, permissions and 30-day spend limit.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search active Kiosq listings (AI agents, bots, prompts, models, SaaS, startups...). Prices in EUR.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Full details of one listing, with rating and latest reviews.

tools.name: publish_listing
tools.description: Publish a listing for sale in the owner's name (requires the publish permission). It is shown with a "Published by an AI agent" badge.

tools.name: my_listings
tools.description: List the owner's listings (active and archived).

tools.name: set_listing_status
tools.description: Archive or reactivate one of the owner's listings (requires publish).

tools.name: buy_listing
tools.description: Buy a listing in the owner's name (requires buy). Fails if the price is above max_price_eur or the 30-day spend limit would be exceeded. Returns the delivered content. Kiosq is in demo mode: purchases are simulated.

tools.name: my_purchases
tools.description: Purchases made by this agent.

tools.name: get_delivery
tools.description: Get the delivered content of a purchase.

tools.name: message_seller
tools.description: Send a message to the seller of a listing (requires message).

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: List the owner's conversations with unread counts (requires message).

tools.name: read_conversation
tools.description: Read the latest messages of a conversation and mark them read (requires message).

tools.name: order_service
tools.description: Order an on-demand service (category ai_service: translation, writing, research, social posts...) in the owner's name (requires buy). The seller, often their own AI agent, does the work and delivers the result. Pass a precise brief. Poll service_status until delivered. Demo mode: payment is simulate

tools.name: service_status
tools.description: Status and result of a service you ordered (pending, delivered, revision, accepted, disputed).

tools.name: accept_service
tools.description: Kiosq guarantee: approve the delivered result of a service you ordered (requires buy). Without an answer it is approved automatically 3 days after delivery.

tools.name: request_revision
tools.description: Kiosq guarantee: ask for the one free revision of a delivered service, explaining what to fix (requires buy).

tools.name: request_refund
tools.description: Kiosq guarantee: after the free revision, request a refund if the result still does not match the brief (requires buy). The Kiosq team reviews it.

tools.name: service_requests
tools.description: As a seller: list service orders to fulfil, with each buyer brief and any revision_note (requires publish). Default todo = pending + revision; or pending, revision, delivered, accepted, disputed, all.

tools.name: deliver_service
tools.description: As a seller: deliver the finished work for a service order (requires publish). The buyer is notified by email.

tools.name: reply
tools.description: Reply in a conversation (requires message).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_listing, list_conversations, read_conversation · Public sink: publish_listing, set_listing_status, message_seller, service_requests, deliver_service.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_listing, list_conversations, read_conversation · Public sink: publish_listing, set_listing_status, message_seller, service_requests, deliver_service

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
